title: Carnotaurus: Complete Overview
name: Carnotaurus: Complete Overview
description: Carnotaurus ("meat-eating bull") was a carnivore dinosaur of the Late Cretaceous (72-69 million years ago), reaching about 8 m. Bull horns; comically tiny arms even for a theropod. # Carnotaurus — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What does the name Carnotaurus mean?", "meat-eating bull"),

    ("What is found in?", "South America"),

for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):

    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
